idea-plugin.name: Nordic
idea-plugin.description:
A port of nordic.nvim (default options) with Rust highlighting mapped from what Neovim actually renders with treesitter and rust-analyzer semantic tokens.
  • Nordic editor color scheme (Settings | Editor | Color Scheme)
  • Nordic Islands UI theme (Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance)
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0: first release: Nordic editor color scheme (every Rust key mapped from Neovim's treesitter + rust-analyzer rendering, plus TOML, Markdown, JSON, YAML, console and diagnostics) and the Nordic Islands UI theme.
